Name: Do You Wanna Build a Snowman
Author: slpOff
Description:
This mod was made purely for fun.It lets you edit the opening and closing times of shops and houses across the valley.The game automatically detects all indoor locations and registers their door schedules.
You can tweak the hours through the config or GMCM if you like seeing the town move at your own pace.It’s not meant to be serious — just a small side project to play around with how the world feels when time works differently.
